title: Small & Micro Wedding Venues in Chicago, With Prices
description: 8 small and micro wedding venues in Chicago, $400 to $2,900, each price from the venue's own site. Checked Oct 28, 2026.
h1: Small & micro wedding venues in Chicago
answer_html:
As of Oct 28, 2026, small wedding venues in Chicago start at $400 for just the two of you and $400 for venues that seat 10 or more (Garfield Park Conservatory: Jensen Room, Monday to Thursday, 4 hours, private rate). The 8 venues we verified go up to $2,900.

Each price and guest count is quoted from the venue's own website and shows the day we read it.

faq.q: What is a normal cost for a wedding venue in Chicago?
faq.a: The middle price of the 8 venues printed on this page is $1,100, and 3 of them are under $1,000 ($400 to $2,900 overall). A price covers only what the venue names: its hours, days and guest limit, so read the card before you compare.

faq.q: What are some cheap wedding venues in Chicago under $1,000?
faq.a: 3 of the 8 venues print a price under $1,000: Garfield Park Conservatory: Jensen Room $400; Garden Club of Evanston: Shakespeare Garden $500; Oak Park Conservatory: ceremony only $600. Prices are for the package or hours each venue names, so read the row before you book.

faq.q: What is a small wedding considered?
faq.a: There is no official cutoff, so we use each venue's own words: the guest limits printed on this page run from 30 to 100 people. Every venue here prints its price for a small, micro, weekday or elopement booking.

faq.q: How much does a micro wedding cost in Chicago?
faq.a: The venue prices we read run $400 (Garfield Park Conservatory: Jensen Room) to $2,900 (Cheney Mansion: weekday wedding). The low end is a ceremony-only slot; the high end is a package with more included. Food, a dress and rings are extra.

faq.q: Is $5,000 enough for a wedding in Chicago?
faq.a: For a small group, yes: the Garfield Park Conservatory's Jensen Room is $400 for four hours, Monday to Thursday (room for up to 100; no bookings after 3 pm), and the most expensive venue on this page is $2,900 (Cheney Mansion, weekday). Either leaves most of $5,000 for the rest of the day. A 100-guest wedding with dinner is a different budget; this page prices small groups only.

pay_less.t: Many venues print a lower price for Monday to Thursday. The Garfield Park Conservatory's Jensen Room is $400 Monday to Thursday. Cheney Mansion's weekday price is $2,900.
A package adds an officiant, photos or decor you may not need, and its price shows it. Ask what the room costs on its own.
A ceremony and a toast fit in an hour or two. The Oak Park Conservatory rents a 2-hour ceremony-only slot for $600. First Unitarian's Hull Chapel is a 3-hour block at $1,500.
Fees, deposits and extra hours can sit on top of the printed price. At the Jensen Room, extra hours are $100 each and a deposit of up to $500 applies. Cheney Mansion adds a $500 security deposit.
Which dates are open? What is the guest limit? Is there a cheaper day or a shorter slot? Put the answers in writing before you pay a deposit.
